description: Compare the SAME module across 2-4 of your extraction jobs in one aligned table, instead of reading each job. Rows align on key_field (default: the pin or register identifier) and compare value_field (default: the name); pass `keys` for specific pins or registers. Parts are never merged: values are positional per job, and a key missing from one part is null there. A job whose outputs expired, whose module is empty or unreadable is listed with its problem, never dropped. Differences come first and differingRows counts every row, not only the returned page (totalRows beside it). Get job ids from datasheetvend_search_my_extractions. Reads the recorded state of your account's own jobs (owner, or TEAM-shared in your workspace; a refunded job is refused): nothing is extracted and no model is called. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key.

items.description: An extraction job in your account.

key_field.description: Field to align rows on, for example 'pin_number'.

module.description: The module to compare, for example pinout, register_map, absolute_max.

value_field.description: Field whose values are compared, for example 'pin_name'.

name: datasheetvend_compare_extractions
title: Compare one module across extractions
